name: text-effect
title: Text Effect
description: Text enters piece by piece with a preset (blur, fade-in-blur, scale, fade, slide) split per character, per word or per line, with the source's stagger times, and can leave in reverse.
useWhen: A headline or sentence needs a clean staggered entrance and the split (letters, words, lines) and the look (blur, slide, scale, fade) should be a choice.
One block should cover several simple reveal styles.
avoidWhen: A very specific reveal such as a mask wipe or a rise from a clipped line: use mask-reveal-up or per-character-rise.
Words should land on a speech rhythm: use the caption blocks.
author: ibelick

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Text to reveal. A new line starts a new line when per is line.

variables.label: Split
variables.description: Reveal per character, word or line.

variables.label: Delay
variables.description: Seconds before the first piece starts.

variables.label: Reveal speed
variables.description: Higher values shorten the gap between pieces.

variables.label: Segment speed
variables.description: Higher values shorten the animation of each piece.

variables.label: Leave at the end
variables.description: Play the reverse (last piece first) near the end.
